{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Democratic Socialists of America endorses the vision and policy demand statement of the Freedom is the Future campaign.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Freedom is the Future campaign is organized by the US Campaign for Palestinian Rights and the Adalah project.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US Campaign for Palestinian Rights and the Adalah project are two of the largest U.S.-based Palestine solidarity organizations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A large number of leftist and progressive organizations and individuals in the United States have endorsed the statement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The DSA BDS and Palestine Working Group and the International Committee have endorsed the statement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians in the United States declare that freedom is the future.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians in the United States have a vision of justice grounded in Palestinian demands for freedom and self-determination.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians in the United States demand the right to return to their homeland.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians in the United States demand the space to thrive.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Palestinians in the United States demand the right to resist for a better world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"There is a global divide between those who believe in freedom and dignity for all and those who justify oppression and supremacy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The Palestinian struggle for freedom from Israel’s daily violence against Palestinians and ongoing settler colonization of Palestinian land is part of a universal struggle for collective liberation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
